# Prepare the invitation

The onboarder reviews one person's preparation beside the untouched shared
plan. Confirm the explicit account and matching plan identity; do not infer
identity from a directory name or copy another person's preparation. Supply
known business details only. Company email, a planned start date and optional
arrangements may remain absent; missing optional details alone do not block
export. Do not collect personal delivery email, phone or home address.

Review selected work and its actual declared section instances. Catalog
membership does not select activities, create arrangements or bind recipient
fields to answers. Answer required onboarder questions explicitly or deliberately
defer them under the existing rules; a template default is not an answer.

Name the preparation's onboarding owner and explicitly designate a known named
business contact with a displayable pre-access help route for export. This is
an organizational assertion, not a network test. Inspect the real first-steps
preview and visible missing information before delivery. Preserve the original
plan, preparation and any newer personal work. Export creates a new archive,
not an import, confirmed identity, first use or verified onboarding outcome.
